pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit a polygonal, tessellated geometry with soft, low-contrast pixel gradients at the boundaries. Individual dark regions are large in relative spatial area, separated by narrow light corridors. Edges appear rounded and non-acute due to image resolution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological graph of intersecting pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank, though blurred at the pixel level.
